text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... It seems my 
finishing kick was lacking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see. How terribly far away it is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"With such a half-hearted run, reaching 
the end of your journey is a pipe 
dream..."
choice_data_list: We need to train even harder.
We need to train even harder, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"With such a half-hearted run, reaching 
the end of your journey is a pipe 
dream..."
choice_data_list: We need to train even harder.
We need to train even harder, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Isn't placing on the board just because it 
was merely 'not bad'?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We will prepare flawlessly and execute an 
airtight strategy. That is how we shall 
dominate the field.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could feel her sheer obsession behind 
those heavily muttered words. She must 
take first place— that was the only 
thought in her mind.
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll make sure you win.
Next time, I'll lead you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, without fail. I believe in you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us train without an ounce of 
compromise.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a concrete plan? What do you 
think is the first issue we should 
address?
choice_data_list: Let's have a talk after the aftercare.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to carefully analyze today's run 
before adjusting the training plan. I 
should align our future direction with her 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...We lost the race, but we still gained 
valuable insights."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No... that is a reasonable proposal. You 
are correct. I was just a bit surprised, 
that's all. You are quite level-headed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was able to believe that the path ahead 
is bright. And that is all thanks to you.
